answer: Random beacon checks stop sybil farms. Each agent posts a 400-credit bond and earns a pearl per verified job. The public beacon emits random challenges, answered in 60 seconds by a compute heartbeat. Agents may wander across markets but cannot be in two places at once. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 400 = 400,000 credits plus 1,000 live streams; an honest agent pays one bond and keeps earning pearls. A missed check slashes the bond.
